content.title: Handheld Night-Market Memory | Host Anchor, Group Reactions, Route Resume
content.summary: Use one handheld host as the memory anchor while sensory stops and brief group reactions expand a fast journey that returns to its route.

quick_start.input_format: One handheld carrier keeps the adult host recognizable. + Every location adds one concrete sensory interaction. + Group reactions briefly widen the memory without replacing the host. + Repeated market lights and steam connect fast cuts. + The ending resumes the original forward route with a retained object.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult radio host entering an indoor flower market with a compact DV camera. A nearby group of older vendors wave and briefly join the frame without displacing the host. Resume following the same host down the aisle as the bouquet remains visible and she turns back to the lens.
